subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite this stale branch on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it only after a replacement owns the linked Dashboard recovery issue?
rationale: The branch crosses current Gateway protocol, shutdown, session-state, and Control UI lifecycle boundaries, so the remaining path is an ownership and merge-risk choice rather than one safe automatic cleanup decision.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original author can update the branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard reconnect/restart proof before another merge review.

options.title: Close after canonical replacement
options.body: If another viable PR becomes the fix path for the linked issue, this stale branch can be closed as superseded instead of merged.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main gateway/UI refactor history makes this the best available owner for the protocol and shutdown semantics choice.
